compiled_rule.technosphere_information_loss: Exact ecoinvent3.9cutoff five-market wood supply screening reconstructions. Retain all original source producer shares and final-product freight rows separately, with signed quantities, supported uncertainties/formulas and no renormalization. Preserve pine/spruce/oak/birch/beech branches and forest-road versus sawmill stages using corresponding native species/stage suppliers. Native DE/SE species-specific forest-road suppliers and RER sawmill chips are explicit geographic proxies for RoW and Quebec; source forest management, allocation, yield, species mix within a labelled class, infrastructure, transport, emissions, land use, density, moisture, carbon content, vintage and internal uncertainty can differ. No softwood-to-hardwood substitution or generic all-hardwood chip portfolio is introduced. All source/native chip references explicitly use kilograms measured as dry mass: factor+1, not wet-mass multipliers2.4or moisture/density/energy scaling. Pulpwood and logs retain cubic metres of solid wood under bark with factor+1, not tonnes or loose-chip volume. Equal reference volume is not equal dry mass, carbon or calorific content; native/source density and carbon inventories are not asserted identical and score effects remain unquantified. Keep native complete species/process inventories and their original resource uptake/allocation; add no carbon-balance correction, uptake credit or energy adjustment. Native precursor/internal forestry transport remains inside production; add only original final-product market freight once. RER rail/heavy-lorry and OCE dry-bulk cargo services retain original tonne-km and modes; fleet/traction/loading/empty-return, geography and vintage differ. Separate caller emissions and carbon-resource exchanges remain unchanged. Only individually inspected exact3.9cutoff profiles qualify. No source exchange omission, consequential/reverse or other-version approval is introduced. Eucalyptus, pellets, bark and residual-wood markets are not approved by this review; their distinct density/co-product and process boundaries need separate work. Full pulp heat, industrial heat and steel transformation/export remain unfinished.
